items.where: Drawing the sector map, definition of sector
items.english: A **sector** is a force or energy that comes onto your land from outside: sun, wind, fire, ...
items.draft: **I-sector** lamandla okanye amandla angena kumhlaba wakho evela ngaphandle: ...
items.backtranslation: A sector [ungrammatical 'lamandla'] energies or energy entering your land from outside
items.problem: Definition has no working predicate; 'lamandla' is a wrong concord and the sentence does not say what a sector is.
items.corrected: **I-sector** yinto enamandla okanye amandla angena kumhlaba wakho evela ngaphandle: ...

items.english: ... a horseshoe-shaped hedge on the uphill side, open end facing downhill.
items.draft: ... ecaleni elingaphezulu ethambekeni, ngomhlaba ovulekileyo ujonge ezantsi.
items.backtranslation: ... on the uphill side, with open ground facing down.
items.problem: 'Open end' of the horseshoe became 'open ground'; the key instruction (leave the end open downhill so cold air drains) is lost.
items.corrected: ... ecaleni elingaphezulu ethambekeni, isiphelo esivulekileyo sijonge ezantsi.
